raw_response:
I've been farming these 9 mu in Quzhou for 45 years. My father taught me everything, and now I mostly do what worked last year and watch my neighbors. I only went to primary school, but I know this land. I have a well, so water is not my biggest worry — fertilizer prices are.

My wheat is already in the ground. I planted 5 mu last October with 30 jin of improved seed per mu, the same kind my neighbor Lao Wang uses — it gave him over 1000 jin per mu last year. Right now the wheat is turning green, so I will put down 100 jin of compound fertilizer per mu as topdressing, and I will irrigate three times before harvest: once now at green-up, once at jointing, and once at grain-filling. I always spray for insects twice and use herbicide once. I expect 1000 jin per mu. I would rather put a little too much fertilizer than risk a bad harvest — a bad year means my family eats less.

After I cut the wheat in early June, I will plant summer maize on those same 5 mu. I use Denghai hybrid seed, about 1 package per mu. I put 80 jin of compound fertilizer down at planting and that is usually enough. Maize does not need much tillage after wheat — I just plant directly. Two irrigations and two insecticide sprays, plus one herbicide spray. I should get about 1100 jin per mu if the weather holds.

I keep 2 mu for cotton. I will rotary-till in April and plant Guoxinmian seed, about 3 jin per mu. Cotton needs a lot of spraying — I do it about 14 times through the season because the bollworms never stop. I put 100 jin of compound fertilizer down at planting and topdress with some urea later. Two irrigations. I expect around 550 jin of seed cotton per mu.

The other 2 mu I plant watermelon. I rotary-till and use plastic film. I put down 100 jin of compound fertilizer plus some sheep manure I got cheap from the village. Watermelon needs water, so I irrigate four times, and I spray pesticide about 5 times total. I should get around 7000 jin per mu if I do not get hit by disease.

I think about money every time I buy a bag of fertilizer. Last year everything cost more, so this year I am not changing much. If Lao Wang does the same as last year, so will I.
